name: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
notes: Official implementation of Mamba, Mamba-2, and Mamba-3. Selective state space models with hardware-aware design inspired by FlashAttention. Contains selective_scan_cuda extension, causal-conv1d, ROCm patch for ROCm 6.0. 18.9k stars. Key for SSM-based inference.
